Context: 4. Extension of JT

## 4. Extension of JT  
Extension of joining time can be granted up to a maximum of 30 days by Heads of Departments and beyond 30 days by the Departments of the Government of India, based on the guiding principle that the total should be approximately equal to 8 days for preparation plus reasonable transit time plus holidays, if any following. - Rule 5 (5).
